tools.name: fix_comfyui_api_prompt_error
tools.description: Diagnose a ComfyUI API-prompt (/prompt) execution error and return the verified fix with corrected JSON. Use when a workflow submitted via the API fails at queue time with missing/invalid input errors or node type mismatches. Do NOT use for drag-and-drop UI workflow issues — API prompts only. Costs

tools.name: diagnose_comfyui_ops
tools.description: Fix ComfyUI operations issues on a remote Linux/DGX Spark host: process detection, restarts, port conflicts, SSH quirks. Use when ComfyUI is down, wedged, duplicated, or unreachable. Do NOT use for workflow/node errors — that's fix_comfyui_api_prompt_error. Costs $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Bas

tools.name: check_dead_end
tools.description: Check whether an approach to ComfyUI video generation is a known dead end before spending GPU time on it. Returns the failed approach, what was tested, and what to do instead. Use BEFORE running an experiment you're unsure about. Covers WanVideoWrapper, chaining, interpolation, and upscaling. Costs

tools.name: get_chaining_rule
tools.description: Get the verified rules for chaining AI video clips into a continuous sequence (MiniMax H3 / Wan). Covers true-last-frame chaining, crossfade vs hard cut decisions, and prompting for pace continuity. Use when assembling multi-clip sequences. Do NOT use for single-clip generation. Costs $0.005 per cal

tools.name: get_audiobook_recipe
tools.description: Get the verified pipeline recipes for long-form TTS audiobook production (Fish-Speech / VibeVoice) and lip-sync (LatentSync). Covers text prep, voice pipeline rules, and lip-sync config. Use when producing narrated audio or syncing dialogue to video. Costs $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List available paid knowledge tools and snippet IDs. Free — call this first to see what's covered.
